digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center outbound comment send path
propositions: DC outbound comment send path does not length-fit bodies before passing to Jira client, causing over-limit comments to be rejected and re-emitted in every sync pass
sanitize_comment method exists in _DCSanitizer with operator warning but has no production caller; fit_comment is wired only in comparison half via outbound_comments._diff_comments
DC send path must route add_comment through _DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment using fit_preserving_marker composition to fit bodies to deployment-resolved ceiling while preserving RECONCILER_MARKER
Dedup key consistency requires _DCSanitizer.fit_comment to be re-derived via fit_comment_as_sent so it matches the marker-stripped body actually landed by the fitted send
Cloud's dead sanitize_comment chain (protocol member, jira_fields._sanitize_comment, acli.py facade) must be removed because its plain character cap would cut RECONCILER_MARKER if wired
In-limit and marker-less bodies must retain byte-identical behavior after wiring the send-path fit
